# freetexttospeech.app

> Free text to speech tool that runs entirely in the browser. Convert any text to natural speech using the Web Speech API — 30 to 100 voices from the user's operating system and browser, adjustable rate, pitch, and volume, optional audio recording. No sign-up, no uploads, no ads, no character limits.

## Key facts

- URL: https://freetexttospeech.app/
- Type: free browser-based utility (progressive web app)
- Technology: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS + Web Speech API + MediaRecorder
- Privacy: all synthesis and recording happens client-side; no text is ever uploaded
- Offline: works offline after first load via service worker
- Cost: free forever
- Part of: Freesuite (https://freesuite.app) — a collection of free browser tools
- License: per-voice licensing belongs to the OS/browser provider; tool itself is free

## What it does

- Reads any pasted or typed text aloud using the browser's built-in voices
- Lets users pick from every voice their OS/browser provides, grouped by language
- Adjusts rate (0.5× to 2×), pitch (0 to 2), volume (0 to 1)
- Plays / pauses / resumes / stops speech on demand
- Highlights the currently-spoken word as it reads
- Can record the synthesised audio to a .webm file (Chrome/Edge)
- Saves last text, voice, rate, pitch, volume to localStorage

## FAQ highlights

- Free forever, no sign-up, no character limit
- All processing local, nothing uploaded
- 30–100 voices from OS and browser
- Download produces .webm (Opus) on Chrome/Edge; Safari/Firefox limited
- Works offline as a PWA
- Compatible with every language the OS ships voices for
